name: california-housing
title: California Housing — 1990 Census block groups
description: 20,640 California block groups from the 1990 Census, with median house value, median income, median housing age, total rooms and bedrooms, population, households and centroid position, as R. Kelley Pace and Ronald Barry published them through StatLib. Brightfield does not carry this data: the start fetches the authors' archive and writes its rows to a Parquet on the reader's machine, in the source's order and units, with no column derived.

licenses.title: No licence declared at source. The data is R. Kelley Pace and Ronald Barry's, issued through StatLib, whose submission terms provide for free distribution and non-commercial use and say nothing on commercial use.

sources.title: houses.zip on StatLib, the archive R. Kelley Pace and Ronald Barry deposited there
Pace, R. Kelley and Ronald Barry, "Sparse Spatial Autoregressions", Statistics and Probability Letters, 33 (1997) 291-297

fields.name: median_house_value
fields.description: Median house value in the block group, in 1990 US dollars. The source tops out at 500,001, which is a ceiling rather than a measurement.

fields.name: median_income
fields.description: Median household income in the block group, as the source records it: values run from about 0.5 to 15, in tens of thousands of 1990 US dollars.

fields.name: housing_median_age
fields.description: Median age of the block group's houses, in years. The source tops out at 52.

fields.name: total_rooms
fields.description: Rooms in the block group, in total.

fields.name: total_bedrooms
fields.description: Bedrooms in the block group, in total.

fields.name: population
fields.description: People resident in the block group.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Block-group centroid latitude. With longitude, this is a map that needs no embedding behind it.
